verdict.rationale: The axis applies because Superset is a team agent-orchestration platform with multi-user plans, but nothing in the evidence shows a lead creating sessions as or for other users. The MCP server acts 'on behalf of a Superset user', meaning the authenticated caller, and automations only produce workspaces a teammate can later open. Neither amounts to delegated or impersonated session creation, admin-on-behalf permissions, or assigning a launched session to another org member.
